description: Find the hold time at which the gate freezes and part weight stops rising. Seal is the first of three consecutive weights within 0.1% of each other that weight does not climb above afterwards; the recommended production hold time adds a margin of one increment (0.5–1.0 s). Weigh to 0.1% of part weight or better. A weight that falls back after seal means the gate did not stay frozen. Run at the velocity the viscosity curve selected.
